content.hebrew: א The master of rescue, the God of salvation, who loves equity, and holds on to justice,
content.transliteration: Adon yeshu‘ot, elowah mosha‘ot, ohev din, oḥez bammishpat

content.hebrew: ב With justice supports equity, and takes vengeance against His people’s enemies, against whom [He directs] His rebuke.
content.transliteration: Bammishpat tomech, bedin, umitnaḳḳem, be’oyevé ‘ammo, bam ga‘arato

content.hebrew: ג His rebuke is against the sea, His greatness is in the land. His word banished the nations of the world.
content.transliteration: Ga‘arato vayyam, godlo vetevel, goyé adama, gerash devaro.

content.hebrew: ד His word is His emissary, His words are in His works. There is silence in His presence, [in the divine chariot, where there is] the appearance of the angelic beings.
content.transliteration: Devaro sheluḥo, devarav bema‘asav, demama lefanav, demut haḥayyot.

content.hebrew: ה The angelic beings bear the splendor of His tremendum. At the beginning of time, He prepared and created [the universe].
content.transliteration: Haḥayyot nose’ot, hod emato, hu millefanim, hechin ufa‘al.

content.hebrew: ו The righteous acted [uprightly], and trampled the wicked; the evil plotted, and their memory perished.
content.transliteration: Ufa‘al tsaddiḳ, ve‘issa rasha‘, vezamam zed, ve’avad zichro.

content.hebrew: ז Perished their memory, their power was broken, their progeny was destroyed – [but] on the pure ones He had compassion.
content.transliteration: Zichro avad, zero‘o nishbar, zar‘o nishmad, zakkim ḥamal.

content.hebrew: ח He had compassion for His people, He had mercy for His dwelling [the Temple] – but to those that plotted evil, in darkness He buried.
content.transliteration: Ḥamal ‘al ‘ammo, ḥas ‘al me‘ono, ḥoshevé ra‘ot, ḥashukkim taman.

content.hebrew: ט He buried in the dust those that put together lies. He buried them, to be buried, ere they became powerful.
content.transliteration: Taman be‘afar, tofelé chezavim, temanam battamun, terem yitgabbaru.

content.hebrew: י Powerful became the wicked, [but] their destruction befell them. He hastens upon them the day of extermination.

content.transliteration: Yitgabberu resha‘im, yavo edam, yaḥish ‘alehem, yom killayon.

content.hebrew: כ Extermination, complete, was decreed for them. Complete extermination weighed down for them.
content.transliteration: Killayon ḥaruts, karut alehem, kala veneḥeratsa, kaveda lahem.

content.hebrew: ל For them He left no root; He extinguished their lamp, he destroyed the foe, he put an end to wars.
content.transliteration: Lahem lo ‘azav shoresh, leva‘er ner, lehashmid tsar, lehashbit milḥamot.

content.hebrew: מ Wars he made cease from the [Israelite] nation He acquired; He spared His people from a bow of bronze.
content.transliteration: Milḥamot hishbit, miggoy ḳana, millet ‘ammo miḳḳeshet neḥusha.

content.hebrew: נ Bronze He made them; those that had been trembling now rejoiced. To spread out [in battle over] the beloved [Jews], they made their plot.
content.transliteration: Neḥusha samo, nivhalim nits-halu, netosh neḥemadim, natenu sodam.

content.hebrew: ס Their plot He overturned, closing up their thoughts. His nation’s princes praised His might.
content.transliteration: Sodam sillef, seḡor sar‘afemo, saré ‘ammo, silselu ‘uzzamo.

content.hebrew: ע Might He is for them, He clothed them in might. The might of their ancestors, the helper – He redeemed them.
content.transliteration: ‘Uzzamo hu, ‘oz hilbisham, ‘oz avotam, ‘ozer padam.

content.hebrew: פָּדָם מִצָּר : פִּלֵּשׁ צוֹרְרָם : פִּצֵּל עָרִיצִים : פּוֹעֵל צַדִּיק:
content.transliteration: Padam mits-tsar, pillesh tsoreram, pits-tsel ‘aritsim, po‘el tsaddiḳ.
content.english: פ He redeemed them from the foe, He bored through their enemy, He split the haughty – He, the doer, the righteous.

content.hebrew: צַדִּיק הוּא : צְדָקוֹת אָהֵב : צִדְקוֹת אֲבוֹתֵֽימוֹ : צָפוּי לוֹ קֹֽדֶם:
content.transliteration: Tsaddiḳ hu, tsedaḳot ahev, tsidḳot avotemo, tsafuy lo ḳodem.
content.english: צ Righteous is He, and He loves righteousness. The righteousness of their ancestors is seen to Him before [and in that merit He rescues their descendants].

content.hebrew: קֹֽדֶם רֹֽגֶז : קָדְמָה יְשׁוּעָה : קֹֽדֶם צָרָה : קִדְּמָה רְוָחָה:
content.transliteration: Ḳodem roḡez, ḳadema yeshu‘a, ḳodem tsara, ḳiddema revaḥa.
content.english: ק Before the disaster there is already rescue; before the trouble there is already respite.

content.hebrew: ר,ש Respite for His people – they prayed, and were helped. He brought back the captives; the tribes He supports.
רְוָחָה עַל עַמּוֹ : שָׁוְעוּ וְנֶעֱזָרוּ : שָׁב שְׁבוּת : שְׁבָטִים תּוֹמֵךְ:
content.transliteration: Revaḥa ‘al ‘ammo, shave‘u vene‘ezaru, shav shevut, shevatim tomech.

content.hebrew: תּוֹמֵךְ תְּמִימִים : תִּעֵב תַּעְתּוּעִים : תֵּחַת לְשׁוֹנוֹ : תָּלָה עַל־הָעֵץ:
content.transliteration: Tomech temimim, ti‘ev ta‘tu‘im, teḥat leshono, tala ‘al ha‘ets.
content.english: ת He supports the blameless, He despises perversity. The one whose tongue trembled / He hanged on a tree.

content.hebrew: עַל־הָעֵץ תָּלָה : לְשׁוֹנוֹ תֵּחַת : תַּעְתּוּעִים תִּעֵב : תְּמִימִים תּוֹמֵךְ:
content.transliteration: ‘Al ha‘ets tala, leshono teḥat, ta‘tu‘im ti‘ev, temimim tomech.
content.english: On a tree He hanged, the one whose tongue trembled, perversity He despises, the one that supports the blameless.
